title: Who Should Visit and Who Should Skip

content.text: Crown Casino Melbourne alone contributes about AUD 1.9 billion a year to the Victorian economy, while Perth adds about AUD 1.2 billion to Western Australia. Online, the group also runs Betfair Australasia, a betting exchange for Australian and New Zealand customers.

items: **Event planners:** Ballrooms, theatres and conference halls in all three cities handle anything from a board dinner to a 1,500-guest gala.
**Players who want structure:** Crown Casino Perth sets mandatory time and loss limits and sends activity statements, so you always know where you stand.
**Food lovers:** Hatted restaurants such as Nobu, a'Mare and Rockpool, plus casual food halls, make each resort a dining destination on its own.
**Families with teenagers:** the gaming floors and bars are strictly 18+, with no exceptions even when a parent comes along.
**Anyone who wants to play anonymously:** you need to verify your identity with an ID document and proof of address before your first withdrawal, so fully anonymous play isn't an option.
**Machine players in Sydney:** Crown Casino Sydney runs table games only, with no machines on the floor.
